author: Bobby Grayson
description: Procedure: copy elixir/ to scratch, symlink .lake/build/bin/replay, sed the mutant into src/*.ex, run fuzz.exs --seed 1 --runs 200; expect MISMATCH + exit 1.
title: Fuzzer sensitivity check (scratch copy, not committed): BEAM bank mutant 'withdraw when n < b' is caught at seed 1 run 0 (Lean 'bank 15' vs BEAM after the boundary withdraw); ttl mutant 'ignore get when v == 3' is caught at seed 1 run 5 (values none vs some). So the comparison is not vacuous: both observables and both examples are load-bearing.
